for (n, k) in [(7, 3), (10, 2), (41, 3)]
    people = collect(1:n)
    removed = Int[]
    index = 0
    while !isempty(people)
        index = mod(index+k-1, length(people))
        push!(removed, popat!(people, index+1))
    end
    println("n=", n, " k=", k, ": ", join(removed, " "))
    println("survivor: ", removed[end])
end
